sections.implementation: After fresh sampling, delta=Inverse(referenceLocalRotation)*sampledLocalRotation; choose shortest quaternion hemisphere; output=referenceLocalRotation*SlerpUnclamped(identity,delta,amplitude). Apply selected local bones from their original snapshots, never from last-frame modified pose. Test1.35 visually before locking; reduce if skin/feet break. Any displayed amplitude multiplier must reflect this actual implemented value, not a game statistic.

implementation.normalizedTarget: For upper+forearm reach L, target relative to initial shoulder = bodyForward*0.90L + worldUp*0.15L; translated shoulder offset candidate=bodyForward*0.12L. Confirm actual anatomical axes and target reach from chosen rig, no hardcoded Euler-axis assumption.
implementation.equalEndpointInvariant: Both cases must meet same target within0.002L or fail QA; do not move the target to hide an unreachable pose.
implementation.solve: Geometric two-bone position solve in plane defined by shoulder,target,pole; preserve lengths. Rebuild rotations from actual bone-child axes, not assumed local+X.
implementation.failurePolicy: If vendor shoulder translation exposes a skin gap, reduce range or use a clearly labelled owned articulated rig; do not silently change the lesson to two unequal targets.
implementation.measurements: Only our own transform target/error may be displayed; not game measurements.

qa: Actual model skin deforms smoothly around shoulder at both limits.

Hand target equality is checked numerically from evaluated transforms and visually.
No hand target/arrow overlaps captions or hides contact.
